title: Quartiles by exam score
prompt: Return student, score, and quartile — split all students into 4 roughly equal-sized groups by score descending using NTILE(4), where quartile 1 contains the highest scorers. Use a window function.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE exam_scores (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, student TEXT, score INTEGER); INSERT INTO exam_scores VALUES (1,'Alice',95),(2,'Bob',88),(3,'Carol',76),(4,'Dave',65),(5,'Eve',59),(6,'Frank',82),(7,'Grace',90),(8,'Heidi',70);
reference_sql: SELECT student, score, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY score DESC) AS quartile FROM exam_scores;
